title: Monotonicity of space classes
statement: Let $s_1,s_2:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. If $s_1(n)\le s_2(n)$ for every $n\in\mathbb{N}$, then every language decidable in space $s_1$ up to a constant factor is also decidable in space $s_2$ up to a constant factor.
